Ingestion
Entry: Unstructured user inputs, including a natural-language request and user-supplied materials such as PDF, Markdown, office documents, datasets, code repositories, URLs, or pasted content.
Exit: A source-linked raw requirement inventory, where each raw requirement points back to the user's natural-language request or supplied input material that expressed it.

1. Natural-Language Request Capture

Receive users' original natural language request, command, and goal. Intake only, no modification, and no further interpretation.

Prompt, file, and workspace context ingestion
【中文注释】输入：wiki、memory、历史对话、知识库条目、graph/context 状态和用户补充材料；处理：读取、登记、同步或更新知识/记忆上下文，并保留来源、索引和审批边界；输出：可检索的知识/记忆更新、graph/context 状态、source-linked 摘要或明确阻塞/缺失说明。测试下钻覆盖：workflow boundary (1): add source readback.。

2. User-Supplied Material Import

receive uers' attachment (PDF, .md, .doc, code, data set, url, etc.) files

Ingest local research source artifacts
【中文注释】输入：本地或外部研究资料、论文文件、URL/arXiv ID、已有 workspace 状态；处理：解析、标准化并登记研究来源，同时保留 provenance 和 parse 状态；输出：research paper/source artifact、memory/graph sidecar、注册状态或解析失败说明。测试下钻覆盖：input class (6): markdown fixture; add source happy/overwrite; tex fixture.。

3. Intake Context Binding

like the input to the right user, session, project, workspace, and the correct historical context, to avoid the input go off rail

Apply approved wiki page edits
【中文注释】输入：用户指定的 wiki/raw 目标、审批引用和前后状态；处理：按批准范围新增、删除或修改知识/源材料，并记录 mutation proof；输出：更新后的目标文件、before/after 证据、索引/日志更新或明确阻塞。测试下钻覆盖：side effect (2): approved wiki edit.。

4. Input Normalization, Cleaning & Deduplication

unify input formats, remove duplicated content and submission, while keeping meaningful nuance changes and separate sources

Apply approved raw-source additions and deletions
【中文注释】输入：用户指定的 wiki/raw 目标、审批引用和前后状态；处理：按批准范围新增、删除或修改知识/源材料，并记录 mutation proof；输出：更新后的目标文件、before/after 证据、索引/日志更新或明确阻塞。测试下钻覆盖：side effect (2): missing confirmation negative | workflow boundary (1): add source readback.。

5. Intake Provenance Registration

record the change that each original input goes through (where it's from, where to access original input, what formatting is applied, etc.)

Fan in selected sources into the research workspace
【中文注释】输入：本地或外部研究资料、论文文件、URL/arXiv ID、已有 workspace 状态；处理：解析、标准化并登记研究来源，同时保留 provenance 和 parse 状态；输出：research paper/source artifact、memory/graph sidecar、注册状态或解析失败说明。测试下钻覆盖：workflow composition (2): one failure among many.。

6. Source-Linked Raw Requirement Extraction

extract the raw requirement from the now formatted input, and note down the origin of each requirements. No interpretation here, only the extraction of the raw requirements.

Record approval, before/after, and mutation proof
【中文注释】输入：用户指定的 wiki/raw 目标、审批引用和前后状态；处理：按批准范围新增、删除或修改知识/源材料，并记录 mutation proof；输出：更新后的目标文件、before/after 证据、索引/日志更新或明确阻塞。测试下钻覆盖：side effect (4): approval/overwrite; approval missing/approved; approved/unapproved.。

Check if the requirement is readable, tracable, and contain all necessary information.
Missing info will be noted, but would be left to W2 to resolve
